user.title: Pair with the TV
user.description: Install the Home Assistant add-on on the TV first (manager app > Add-ons > Repositories > add larsoss/cleanyourtv-webos-homeassistant@main/tv-addon, then install Home Assistant). On the TV open the add-on's page and choose Pair Home Assistant: it shows a 6-digit code.

data_description.host: The IP address of the TV, best a fixed one in your router.
data_description.code: The 6 digits on the TV screen. A code works once.
data_description.device_name: The TV lists Home Assistant under this name on the add-on's page.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: The TV at {host} no longer accepts Home Assistant (it was removed on the TV). On the TV open the Home Assistant add-on's page, choose Pair Home Assistant and enter the new code.

error.cannot_connect: The TV did not answer. Is it on, on the same network, and is the Home Assistant add-on installed and switched on?
error.too_many_tries: Too many tries. Wait a minute.
error.too_many_devices: Too many Home Assistants are paired. Remove one on the TV.
error.not_waiting: The TV is not waiting for a code. On the TV open the Home Assistant add-on's page and choose Pair Home Assistant.
error.wrong_code: That code is not right. Check the 6 digits on the TV.

abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.

data_description.live_sources: Adds the channels of your Live TV playlist to the media player's source list. A long playlist makes the list long.

no_mac.message: The MAC address of the TV is not known yet: turn the TV on once with its own remote while Home Assistant is connected.

unknown_command.message: Unknown command: {command}. Use a key name (UP, ENTER, HOME, VOLUMEUP, RED, 1 ...) or text:, launch:, live:, enter, delete, click.

send_text.name: Send text
send_text.description: Types text into the text field that is open on the TV.

launch_app.name: Open app
launch_app.description: Opens an app or input on the TV. The remote's attributes list the ids.

live_channel.name: Live TV channel
live_channel.description: Opens Live TV of CleanYourTV on a channel of your playlist.

tv_power.name: Power
tv_power.description: One of the power calls of the TV.

action.name: Action
action.description: off: screen off; on: screen on; standby; reboot; shutdown (only the TV's own remote turns it back on).

pointer.name: Pointer
pointer.description: Moves the TV's pointer, clicks or scrolls.

refresh_lists.name: Refresh lists
refresh_lists.description: Reads the apps, inputs and Live TV channels of the TV again.
